Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 that have an inhibitor mechanism of action. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_mechanism on molregno, filter drug_mechanism.action_type = 'INHIBITOR'. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid to get target details. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
